# IR-EMPOWER 2026: registration open

The second edition of **IR-EMPOWER**, the community workshop on infrared
emissivity measurement, takes place on **28–29 September 2026** at the Center
for Applied Energy Research (CAE), Würzburg, Germany. Founded in 2024 and
first organized by the Thermomat / HAIRL group at UPV/EHU in Bilbao, the
workshop covers measurement techniques and protocols, intercomparisons and
databases, modelling and simulation, and thermophysical metrology and
applications.

**Registration** (per the official page): 200 € regular / 150 € students
before 31 July 2026; 250 € / 200 € afterwards.
**Poster abstracts:** due 31 July 2026.

[**Official workshop page & registration (CAE) →**](https://cae-zerocarbon.de/IR-Empower-Workshop.html)
